items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Tech Mahindra, Infosys lead 300-pt gain in Sensex; SMIDs trade mixed
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap fell 0.19 per cent and 0.14 per cent, respectively

items.title: Silver outlook bearish; may fall to $48 if $54.50 support breaks: Analyst
items.description: Praveen Singh of Mirae Asset Sharekhan said that silver has fallen quite sharply in the last few weeks. The white metal looks weaker than gold, as ETF flows are not inspiring.

items.title: Sell gold on rallies as rate hike concerns weigh: Mirae Asset Sharekhan
items.description: Praveen Singh of Mirae Asset Sharekhan has said that spot gold is facing tremendous selling pressure on rate hike concerns as inflation continues to run hot. It is advisable to sell into rallies.

items.title: Asian stocks rebound after tech sell-off; Indonesia market plunges 11%
items.description: Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI recover after steep losses as concerns over AI financing weigh on sentiment, while MSCI's move to downgrade Indonesia's market status triggers a sharp sell-off

items.title: Jio Financial shares drop 2.5% as Q2 PAT halves; MOFSL cuts FY27 estimates
items.description: Jio Financial share: Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services said healthy execution continued to drive growth, but higher provisions prompted earnings estimates cut for FY27.

items.title: Nifty IT soars 14% in 6 days on Q2 earnings boost; TechM, Wipro, TCS shine
items.description: At 10:12 AM on Friday, the Nifty IT index was the top sectoral gainer, up 2.8%. Tech Mahindra, Wipro, Infosys and TCS surged up to 7% amid Q2 earnings cheer.

items.title: HDFC Life Insurance sheds 3% post Q2 results; brokerages remain upbeat
items.description: Analysts at Systematix Institutional Research and Elara Securities retained a 'Buy' rating on HDFC Life stock, highlighting that Value of New Business in Q2 came in ahead of Q2 estimates.

items.title: Cyient DLM tanks 19% on huge volumes post Q2 results; here's why
items.description: Cyient DLM's Q2 earnings showed that execution was slightly impacted by supply chain lead times and margins were softer while the order book was strong.

items.title: Gold ETFs hold firm, gain up to 1% despite mutual fund investment curbs
items.description: Fresh lump-sum investments, new SIP registrations and SIP step-ups in these FoFs have been suspended, while existing SIPs will continue as usual.

items.title: Indian software stocks set to outperform AI peers by most margin in decades
items.description: India's top software exporters have surged over 10% this week as global chip stocks fall 7.4%, with analysts pointing to AI valuation concerns and signs of improving revenue growth in the IT sector

items.title: Q2 impact: TechM shares gain 8% as analysts raise earnings estimate, target
items.description: Tech Mahindra shares jumped 5 per cent and emerged as the top Sensex gainer after the Q2 results. SBI Securities said that it expects Tech Mahindra stock to outperform the broader IT sector and peers.

items.title: Nestle India shares tank 9% in 2 days as firm flags inflation risks in Q2
items.description: Analysts said that Nestle India's sales growth is expected to be optically lower in H2FY27 vs H1FY27, which is more due to the base effect and not led by any deterioration in the fundamentals.

items.title: Wipro shares gain nearly 2% after Q2 results; brokerages remain bearish
items.description: Wipro's net profit fell 1.4 per cent year-on-year to ₹3,201 crore in the second quarter of financial year 2027.

items.title: Nifty conquers 20-DMA, now eyes 50-DMA breakout at 23,500: Tech analysts
items.description: Nandish Shah of HDFC Securities expects the 22,776-22,800 resistance band on the Nifty 50 index to now act as immediate support, and sees near resistance in the 23,100-23,150 range.

items.title: Stocks to watch: Jio Fin, Yes Bank, Wipro, L&T Fin, Angel One, Urban Co
items.description: Urban Company, Federal Bank, Punjab National Bank, LTM, Bajaj Housing Finance, Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals, DLF, Jindal Saw, Oberoi Realty, Shoppers Stop,  will report Q2FY27 results today.
